title: Optimal Bounds for the k-Disjoint Paths Problem
summary: The Graph Minors Series of Robertson and Seymour forms the foundation of algorithmic structural graph theory, yielding fixed-parameter algorithms for problems such as Disjoint Paths, Rooted Minor Checking, and Folio. A key ingredient behind the fixed-parameter tractability of the $k$-Disjoint Paths problem is the irrelevant-vertex technique. This machinery is governed by the Vital Linkage Theorem and the so-called Linkage Function $\ell$.
